name: COLORADO HOME SAUNA
description:
The Colorado Home Infrared Sauna is a beautiful 1 to 2 person Far Infrared Home Sauna designed to help individuals achieve optimal wellness. Ideal for compact and smaller spaces, this healthy oasis is complimentary to any spa, wellness center, or home.

Detoxify your body and discover amazing results with a Colorado Sauna without breaking the bank or taking up large amounts of space. Setup is a breeze - easy to assemble. Plug into any standard household 120V/15A outlet and you're ready to step into relaxing natural warmth in minutes!

Colorado Sauna shown is with standard Hemlock wood.
